content.text:
已完成。`artifacts/literature_map.yaml` 包含 **29 篇论文**，覆盖全部 6 个类别：

| 类别 | 数量 | 代表性论文 |
|------|------|-----------|
| Neurosymbolic RL/GRPO | 5 | DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeekMath (GRPO原始), Logic-RL, SatLM, Mellgren Prolog-GRPO |
| Reward shaping | 4 | Let's Verify Step by Step (PRM), RLVR, Rubric-GRPO, PAR |
| Mutation testing | 7 | DeMillo 1978 (经典), Offutt coupling effect, Jia & Harman survey, LLMorpheus, Meta mutation-guided, Just et al. 2014 |
| Intensional analysis | 1 | DeepMutation DNN |
| Reward hacking | 4 | InfoRM (NeurIPS'24), MO-GRPO, Energy Loss (ICML'25), Survey 2026 |
| FOL/Prolog formalization | 8 | FOLIO, ProofWriter, Logic-LM, LINC, FoVer, LoRP, NL2FOL, LogiQA 2.0 |

每篇论文包含 role（direct-competitor / method-component / evaluation / background）和与 STA 的具体关联说明。
